findings.summary: Automation and results installer callback/return maps are exact in source: 18 callbacks each; automation returns 6 keys and results returns 17 keys. No fixture directly asserts all map cardinalities or malformed-map rejection.

ResultPipeline forwards to original store and maps only claimAction to claimLocalDelivery. Permission reads current audit/native facts plus public task/getPolicy wrappers. Public wrappers do not expose transaction-opening calls, but no allowed fixture proves behavior under the original claim lock; do not treat as demonstrated failure or executable proof.

Event pair configuration, owner ingress, schedule registration and polling are explicit operations; composition does not configure/start automatically. NW02-NW04 source fixtures cover queued ingress/no grant, stale pair, and stopped schedule restart.

Latest client exact-checks nested preview, result artifact/data/verification/verificationBinding, status rows, notification candidate/batch/suppressed/retry maps, and validates displayed byte digests. NW09 and NW11 exercise extra nested fields and original readonly projections. The suspected verification-state enum mismatch was retracted after reading the actual normalVerification return mapping; it is four-state exact.
NW01-NW11 contain no positive genuine-native result through preview, grant, same-ledger claim, local publication, query/access, or notification-group publication.

Client retains uncertain command state and blocks mutations; local adapter query reads current delivery and ResultPipeline reconcile calls query only. NW07 and NW10 cover automation response loss/late acknowledgement, not local delivery dispatch response loss or query recovery.

Runtime admits one producer, audit and results observer (maximum three) and notifies only after original mutation receipts. No fixture covers all three, duplicate subscription rejection, or local plan/grant/publication observation.

Memory continuity uses original owner store, coordinator projection, context assembler, receipt validation and named mutation observer; NW06 source fixture exercises original mutation/history projection but was not run.

bounds: No current native model/environment fact or real local result publication was established.
